morphology.pattern_note: 词根 kekal 不发生辅音变化；加 -an 后，词根末尾的 l 与后续元音连读，形成 ber.ke.ka.lan。ber- 与 ke- 中的 e 均读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 持续存在或延续很长时间，甚至永久，不消失或不发生根本变化。
senses.en_definition: To endure or remain in existence for a very long time or permanently.
senses.ms_definition: Sentiasa ada atau berterusan untuk sepanjang masa atau lama sekali; berlanjutan.
senses.nuances: 属于表达持续状态的不及物动词，也常译为“持久的”。可用于友谊、和平、影响或不利状况，并不自带褒义。语境中的长久延续不一定是字面上的永远。马来文释义据 [DBP：berkekalan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berkekalan) 整理。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kerjasama antara kedua-dua institusi diharapkan dapat berkekalan dan memberikan manfaat kepada masyarakat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 希望两所机构之间的合作能够长久延续，并为社会带来益处。
dual_scenarios.en: It is hoped that cooperation between the two institutions will endure and benefit the community.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Semoga persahabatan kita berkekalan walaupun dah jarang jumpa, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Semoga persahabatan kita berkekalan walaupun kita sudah jarang berjumpa, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 希望咱们就算不常见面，友谊也能一直在，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: Here's hoping we'll stay friends even though we don't meet up much anymore, right?
spoken_features: jumpa 是较口语的形式，标准表达可用 berjumpa。
句末 kan 用于寻求共鸣；祝愿语中的 berkekalan 带有真诚、稍郑重的语气。

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah lama kita tak jumpa. Semoga persahabatan kita berkekalan, kan?
messages.ms_standard: Sudah lama kita tidak berjumpa. Semoga persahabatan kita berkekalan, bukan?
messages.zh: 咱们好久没见了。希望这份友谊能一直走下去，对吧？
messages.en: It's been ages since we met up. Here's hoping we'll always stay friends, right?

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Mestilah! Jauh je, bukan lupa. Nanti kita jumpa lah.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah tentu! Kita hanya berjauhan, bukannya saling melupakan. Kita akan berjumpa nanti.
messages.zh: 当然啦！只是离得远，又不是忘了彼此。改天咱们见个面。
messages.en: Of course! We're just far apart—we haven't forgotten each other. Let's meet up soon.

etymology.historical_story: Berkekalan belongs to the kekal family, whose related forms distinguish enduring from actively preserving something: berkekalan describes continuity, while mengekalkan means maintaining it. DBP illustrates the word through the survival of a written text and the continuation of a curfew. Those contrasting examples show that endurance can describe either something treasured or an unwelcome condition. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=berkekalan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 ke-kal，记住“持续留着”；ber-ke-ka-lan 把这个状态延展开：一直都在，长久不散。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 语气中性而略郑重，适合正式祝愿。婚礼祝福可说 Semoga kebahagiaan kalian berkekalan，意为“愿你们幸福长久”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈友谊、婚姻、和平及长期影响。祝福涉及对方关系时，应考虑熟悉程度；日常描述物品耐用，tahan lama 通常更自然。
